rev.t: I purchased a Samsung Fold 8 Ultra at the Koramangala Samsung Center. The staff explained everything very well; there are two excellent employees there who assist with the applications—Khwaja and Ali. They are very helpful. If you are looking to buy anything from Samsung, do visit the Koramangala branch. Thank you, friends.👍 …

I bought a galaxy s26 phone from here. The support from the staff was excellent. I got good exchange value for my old phone. Also the staff helped to transfer all data from existing phone to new phone.
The staff just tends to sell things to customer. Whenever you go they say today is the last day of offer. I don't think they know how to deal with customers
